Diarrhœa and dysentery; mucous stools like scrapings; stools like rice-water; thin, black; very offensive. Cholera infantum, with putrid discharge like foul eggs. Constipation with offensive breath. Unable to lie down, gasping for breath continually, wants hands held. (Removed in a prover: short breath going up-hill, or upstairs.). Short, hacking cough with tickling in throat; can hardly retain anything in stomach. Stertorous respiration. Soreness of muscles of back and limbs. Twitching in muscles. Aching, rheumatic pains in shoulders. Unable to raise r. arm. Aching, rheumatic pains in arms strongly flexed in tonic spasm. Cold hands and feet. Vesicular itching eruption on hand. Erysipelas of back of r. hand, first three fingers and arm, violet-coloured swelling, rough skin. Rheumatic pain in r. hip-joint. Dragging down buttocks and into thighs. Paralysis of lower extremities; with dragging sensation. Aching soreness beneath l. patella all day up to 4 p.m.; feels as if it would be stiff and sore to move it, but it is not felt during motion. Sharp pain in l. shin. Cramps. Cold hands and feet. Fainting and insensibility, lasting for hours. Pricking like needles all over body. Tonic spasm; arms flexed, difficulty in straightening them. Prostration from a short walk. Offensive discharges.

(In sick :) She had nervous trembling. Trembling, uncertain, straggling walk. Tonic spasms of arms. Trembling and convulsions. Partial convulsive movements. θ Hydrocephaloid. Easily fatigued by least walk. Complains of feeling very tired, even while lying in bed. θ Remittent fever. Feels as if he had taken a bad cold. θ Remittent fever. General malaise, great languor and weakness. Profound prostration ; physical exhaustion ; surface pale, bathed in cold sweat ; collapse. Became thoroughly unfit for study, as every exercise at reading increased all symptoms, especially pressing at occiput. Pains sharp, come suddenly, last a short time, disappear suddenly. Periodical : spells of sick headache. Symptoms go from head downward. Affected right side first and afterwards same parts of left. θ Remittent fever. From left to right : frontal headache. Left : bruised pain beneath tendo-achillis ; aching pain in knee ; pain in thigh ; sharp pain in shin ; dull pain in knee ; frontal headache from left to right ; pressure in temple ; small pustules on vertex ; constant dark spots in front of eye ; eye, watering ; pressing pain in ear ; nostril, stinging ; wing of nose, sensation of fine electric sparks ; swelling and soreness of inner side of cheek ; pain in region of ovary ; larynx very sore to pressure ; dull aching in chest ; oppression of chest and frontal headache, going from left to right ; transient pain under clavicle ; slight tingling along side of chest ; jerking, common carotid ; pain in shoulder like a toothache ; arm, drawing pain ; tingling burning in arm ; aching in forearm, also creeping shuddering ; constant tired heavy feeling in arm. Right : burning pain in temple ; very severe neuralgia over eye and patella ; ear, itching ; in jaw, drawing pain ; itching of cheek ; pustular eruption ; aching of teeth, upper jaw ; sore throat ; chest, pain ; pain in hypochondrium ; inguinal region, crampy stitch ; iliac fossa, tenderness ; senses as of fine electric sparks on sternal end of clavicle ; twitching in sterno-cleido-mastoid muscle ; stitching pain in neck ; rheumatic pain in shoulder ; soreness of muscles ; twitching of arm ; contractive pain in palms of hand ; tingling itching, little finger ; pain in second phalangeal joint of middle finger ; aching in hip and knee ; dull pain in ankle. As if an india-rubber band was stretched tightly over forehead, from temple to temple ; as of fine electric sparks in vertex ; as if brain was swashing about ; as of fine electric sparks left wing of nose ; as if a thousand pins were pricking tongue ; as if a load was pressing in front of chest ; as if diaphragm depressed lungs ; as if compressed, chest ; of fine electric sparks on sternal end of right clavicle ; as though it would be impossible to raise arm ; as of fine electric sparks on middle finger of left hand ; as if just below knee or shin had been touched with a piece of ice ; as if he had taken a bad cold. Pain : over right eyebrow ; under right patella ; from throat into ear ; in right hypochondrium ; in region of left ovary ; in right lung ; severe in lumbo-sacral region ; in right shoulder ; in second phalangeal joint of middle finger of right hand ; in left thigh ; in great toe. Acute piercing pain : on left supraorbital ridge. Sharp : pain in head ; pain centre of cheek ; in right hypochonder ; in left shin. Darting : pain in head. Jagging pains : in head. Stitches : region of heart ; crampy, in left inguinal region ; in right side of neck. Boring pains ; in small of back. Prickling : in vertex ; through glans, penis, and urethra. Twitching : pains through temples ; right sterno-cleido muscle. Beating pain : in both ears. Jerking : in left common carotid artery. Burning : pain in top of head ; in brain ; of lips ; of tongue ; in throat ; in abdomen ; in rectum ; down left arm ; ulcer on lower extremities ; in forehead ; in right temple and vertex ; in stomach. Biting : on tongue. Stinging : in left nostril. Pressing : pain through temples, in top of head ; pain left ear ; in hypochondrium. Pressure : in left temple ; in occiput ; in muscles of back of neck ; under sternum. Drawing : pain left arm ; pain in jaw ; in muscles of neck. Neuralgia : of eyes ; of temples. Dragging : across loins. Bruised : feeling in leg ; pain beneath left tendo-achillis. Rheumatic : pains in right shoulder ; in right hip joint. Distension : in abdomen. Expansive : pains in head. Sore : abdomen ; feeling in legs ; inside of cheeks ; in stomach and bowels ; of respiratory organs ; muscles of back and limbs. Aching : small of back ; pain in shoulders ; left forearm ; in forehead ; in stomach ; of teeth ; of left side of chest ; in both hips and knee ; in left middle of shin bone ; beneath l. patella ; in leg. Dull pain : running from forehead to occiput ; under left clavicle ; in right ankle. Throbbing : entire head. Contracting pain : in palms. Digging feeling : low down in abdomen. Colic-like pains : in abdomen. Crampy stitch : in left inguinal region. Uncomfortable feeling : across stomach and liver. Narrowness : of chest. Tight feeling : in both lungs ; across forehead ; in nose between eyes. Stiff : neck ; feeling in hand. Tired : in renal region ; of left arm. Lame : neck. Sinking feeling : all over abdomen. Faint feeling : spreading from thighs all over body. Horripilation : left forearm. Numbness : of skin of hands ; in head ; in ear. Tingling : of tongue ; in throat ; down left arm ; in ear ; l. side of chest. Tickling : of throat. Full : feeling in throat ; in head ; in stomach. Heavy : as lead, lower extremities ; feeling in head ; of left arm. Weight : on neck ; in epigastrium ; in stomach. Shuddering : left forearm. Creeping : left forearm. Coldness : when nerve of tooth is touched. Chilly : while in a warm room. Hot : abdomen ; in rectum. Itching : lower abdomen ; of scalp ; of right ear ; of nose ; of face ; of anus ; of genitals ; of scrotum and inside of thighs ; of back of neck and back ; in little fingers ; tingling in leg ; of skin. Dryness : in throat ; of mouth and lips. Putrid discharges from mouth, throat, nostrils, ears, rectum and vagina. Œdema of feet, hands and face, with soapy, colorless complexion ; after loss of blood. Scarlatina maligna. Confluent variola ; no secondary fever. Carious bones ; necrosis ; osteosarcoma ; sinuses. TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Carb. ac.]. Touch : tooth, coldness ; l. supraorbital spot sore to. Reading : numbness of head ; pressure in occiput. Extensive scald (in glycerine externally). Burns, especially if they ulcerate and discharge is offensive. Lacerated wounds from blunt instruments ; bones bare or crushed and splintered. Two children, 9 months old. θ Summer complaint. B., æt. 10 ; psoriasis. Lady ; æt. 18 ; variola. Miss, æt. 19 ; hysterical vomiting. Young lady, æt 21 ; variola. Woman, æt 39 ; dyspepsia. Woman, æt. 46, scrofulous diathesis ; chronic ulcers on feet and ankles. Woman, æt. 50 ; carbuncle on hip.

keynotes.text: The potencies are made with alcohol (an exception to the rule of preparing acids). Pains are terrible; come suddenly, last a short time, disappear suddenly (Bell., Mag. p.). Profound prostration, collapse; surface pale and bathed in cold sweat (Camph., Carbo v., Ver.). Physical exertion, even much walking, brings on abscess in some part, but generally in the right ear. - R. T. Cooper. Dull, heavy, frontal headache, as if a rubber band were stretched tightly over the forehead, from temple to temple (Gels., Plat., Sulph.). When burns tend to ulceration and ichorous discharge. Putrid discharges from mouth, nose, throat, nostrils, rectum and vagina (Anthr., Psor., Pyr.). Malignant scarlatina and variola (Am. c.). Lacerated wounds with blunt instruments; bones bare, crushed; much sloughing of soft parts (Calend.). Longing for whiskey and tobacco (Asar., Carbo. v.). Vomiting: of drunkards, in pregnancy, sea-sickness, cancer; of dark, olive-green fluid (Pyr.). Dysentery: fluid mucus, like scarpings of mucus membranes, and great tenesmus (Canth.); diarrhoea, stool thin, involuntary, black, of an intolerable odor. Constipation, with horrible offensive breath (Op., Psor.). Leucorrhoea: acid, copious, fetid, green.

Relations. - Compare: Ars., Kreos, in burns; ulcers with unhealthy, offensive discharges, Gels., Mer., Sulph. Carbolic acid is antidoted by dilute cider vinegar, either externally or internally, when acid has been swallowed accidentally, or taken for suicidal purposes.

color="#800000">CARBOLICUM ACIDUM Phenol-Carbolic Acid Carbolic Acid is a powerful irritant and anæsthetic. A languid, foul, painless, destructive remedy. Stupor, paralysis of sensation and motion, feeble pulse and depressed breathing, death due to paralysis of respiratory centers. Acts primarily on the central nervous system. Increased olfactory sensibility. Produces mental and bodily languor, disinclination to study, with headache like a band. Very marked acuteness of smell is a strong guiding symptom. Stomach symptoms are also important. Pains are terrible; come and go suddenly. Physical exertion brings on abscess somewhere. Putrid discharges (Bapt). Scarlet fever, with marked tendency to destruction of tissue internally, and fetid odor. Spasmodic coughs. Arthritis (See Dose).

Carbolic acid, like the Carbons, is a powerful antiseptic, and its use as such in surgery has led incidentally to the poisoning of both patients and surgeons. These experiences have provided a number of the symptoms indicating its medicinal use. The pains of carbolic acid come suddenly. They are burning and pricking, sticking. The urine is very dark, black or blackish olive-green; grass or olive-green. There is numbness and twitching. Putrid discharges are a marked indication. The skin is inflamed, and other symptoms appear, with burning, tingling, itching, and numbness. Gangrene has been caused by the application of 2 to 5 per cent. solutions. There is profound prostration and fatigue; convulsions; collapse; cold, clammy sweat. Constant yawning. R. K. Ghosh finds it admirable in cases (if cholera where Verat. alb. seems indicated and fails. There is intolerance of warm room; but also sensitiveness to cold air which many symptoms. Many poisoning cases show pneumonia, single or double, affecting the bases principally. Dr. Proctor has recorded a brilliant cure of a double basal pneumonia with drop doses of the B. P. solution, after failure of more commonly used remedies. Nervous dyspepsia of intensely painful character has frequently been cured by it; and R. K. Ghosh has reported great improvement in a case of diabetes when the remedy was given for something else. Proell has recorded his own case of idiopathic erysipelas affecting the back of the right hand, first three fingers and arm, with violet-coloured swelling and roughness. Rhus removed the fever, but did nothing to stop the erysipelas. This Carbol. ac. 30 did promptly. It was prescribed by Dr. Streintz. Fahnestock reports a case of poisoning observed by himself from inhaling the fumes. The patient, a woman, feeling ill, ran across the street to a neighbour's. Before reaching the house she fell prostrate, pale, gasping for breath. When taken in, she had to be propped up in order to breathe; trembled all over; wanted her hands held; "pricking like needles," all over body; unable to raise right arm. Cold hands and feet. Wanted a drink of water every few minutes; nausea but no vomiting; pain in lumbar region. Symptoms lasted four hours. It has been used with success in the vomiting of drunkards; of pregnant women with violent frontal headache. Great flatulent distension of the abdomen, with belching of wind and desire for stimulants, indicates the drug. Palpitation of the heart at night has been cured by it. It has relieved cases of cancer of the stomach, and has apparently cured epithelioma of the cheek and nose, with hæmorrhages (Allen). Deschere has found Carbol. ac. 30 of great service in uterine displacements, with or without discharges, but these, if present, are always offensive. The symptoms first relieved are the agonising backache across the loins with a dragging sensation down the buttocks into the thighs. Cooper regards it as specific in influenza, in the 3x for the attack, and 30th for resulting debility.

A Text-Book of Materia Medica. (Characteristic, Analytical, and Comparative.) By Pr. Allen Corson Cowperthwaite, M. D., PH. D., LL. D. CARBOLICUM ACIDUM Carbolic Acid .- C 6 H 5 O.H. Preparation.- Solution in alcohol. General Analysis.- Acts primarily upon the cerebrospinal nerve centers, destroying their vitality, and thus producing a tendency to deterioration of the solids and fluids of the body, even causing the presence in the latter of animal and vegetable organisms. Thus is readily understood not only its therapeutic action when administered internally, but also its important property, both as a therapeutic and preventive agent, in its destructive influence over the lower grades of organic life, whether vegetable or animal. In very weak solution it instantly destroys vegetable mold, both plant and spores, and operates with equal destructiveness upon minute or microscopic animalcules. Through this power it checks the different fermentations, including putrefaction, and thus acts powerfully as an antiseptic or disinfecting agent. It operates with wonderful efficiency in correcting or preventing putrefaction in animal substances, produces the same effect in the living human subjects, and, through the same influence, corrects or suppresses those fermentative processes in the body which often lead to the most serious results, as purulent infection, poisoned dissecting wounds, carbunculous disease, and hospital gangrene. ( Arch. Gen., 1873 .) Characteristic symptoms. Mind.- (Carbolicum acidum) Disinclination to mental exertion ; very irritable. Head.- (Carbolicum acidum) Dull, heavy headache, as if an India-rubber band were stretched tightly around the forehead. (Ant. tart., Chel., Merc., Nitr. ac., Sulph.) Feeling of tightness across the forehead, above the frontal sinuses. Small pustulous vesicle at left of vertex. Itching of the scalp. (Caust., Graph., Sep., Sil., Sulph.) Eyes.- (Carbolicum acidum) Severe orbital neuralgia over the right eye. (Coloc.) Nose.- (Carbolicum acidum) Sense of smell more acute ; nostrils plugged up. Ozoena, with great fetor, and ulceration. Face.- (Carbolicum acidum) Face pale or flushed, and burning. Throat.- (Carbolicum acidum) Sore throat, worse on the right side. Hawking of clear white mucus. Stomach.- (Carbolicum acidum) Total loss of appetite. Desire for whiskey. (Asar.) Constant belching of large quantities of wind. Excessive nausea, and inclination to vomit. (Ant. tart.) Abdomen.- (Carbolicum acidum) Pain in right hypochondrium ; also in iliac region of both sides. Rumbling and rolling in the abdomen, with a sense of distension. (Cinch., Lyc.) Stool.- (Carbolicum acidum) Cholera infantum, with putrid discharges like foul eggs. Urine.- (Carbolicum acidum) Urine dark ; dark greenish-brown ; dark, smoky color ; alkaline. Female Organs.- (Carbolicum acidum) Menses profuse and dark-colored. Pain in region of left ovary when walking in the open air, soon subsiding. Puerperal fever, with putrid symptoms. Ulceration of the cervix uteri. (Hydras.) Respiratory Organs.- (Carbolicum acidum) Stertorous respiration. (Op.) Short, hacking cough, with tickling in the throat. Feeling of narrowness in the chest, as if the diaphragm depressed the lungs. Back.- (Carbolicum acidum) Soreness of the muscles of the back and limbs. Upper Limbs.- (Carbolicum acidum) Constant tired, heavy feeling in left arm. Soreness of the muscles of the right arm. Aching pain in left forearm. Lower Limbs.- (Carbolicum acidum) Lower extremities feel heavy as lead. Aching soreness beneath left patella ; feels as if it would be stiff and sore to move it, but it is not felt at all during motion. Aching pain in left shin bone. Sharp pain in left shin bone. Generalities.- (Carbolicum acidum) Great languor and profound prostration. Easily fatigued by the least walk. Feels as if she had taken a violent cold. Skin.- Itching of the skin on various parts of the body. (Sulph.) Vesicular eruption all over the body, which itches excessively ; better after rubbing, but leaving a burning pain. (Sulph.) Therapeutic Range.- (Carbolicum acidum) Diseases with a putrid tendency, as scarlet fever, diphtheria, typhoid, etc. ; unhealthy putrid discharges from mucous surfaces ; catarrh ; aphthae ; effects of bad drainage ; Bright's disease ; pruritus ; prurigo ; irritable ulcers ; confluent variola ; laryngitis ; bronchitis ; phthisis ; dyspepsia ; morning sickness ; diarrhoea ; sick headache ; cerebro-spinal irritation ; ulceration of the cervix uteri. Compare.- (Carbolicum acidum) Ars., Bapt., Gels., Kreos., Lach., Phos., Nitr. ac., Mur. ac., Rhus tox., Sulph. Antidote.- (Carbolicum acidum) Saccharate of lime in solution. Aching and burning pain in forehead, > by pressure of cold hand. Dull frontal headache in centre of forehead. Dull frontal headache : with chilliness ; with general lassitude ; > in open air. Feeling of tightness across forehead, directly above frontal sinuses. Dull frontal headache, as if an india-rubber band was stretched tightly over forehead, from temple to temple. Feeling in top of head as if brain was swashing about. Headache in upper half of head, in morning. Dull pressure and pain in occiput and muscles of back of neck, especially just behind ears. Expansive pains in head, with swimming before eyes. Head felt as if enclosed in a band, which at times seemed to compress and crush in head, < in temples. Fulness of head all over brain, with dull pains. Head feels very heavy. Numbness in head after reading, with pressure in temples. Headache, with nausea, > by a cup of green tea. Pressure or a tight bandage, > headache temporarily, also > while smoking after tea ; < bending head forward. Reading < pressure in occiput. Severe burning in brain, over eyebrows in evening. (In sick :) Her brain throbbed and entire head ached. Rush of blood to head, face flushed. Congestive headache. Basilar meningitis ; acute hydrocephalus. Periodical spells of sick headache, about time of catamenia. Tinea capitis ; vermin on head ; itching of scalp. Scalp sensitive to touch, could not comb or brush hair. Sweat on head from least exertion. Sensation of coldness, like cold sensation experienced when nerve of tooth is touched, in one spot on head, stooping, followed by clammy sweat. Cold clammy moisture on head. Feels like rubbing head and eyes. Retraction of head. θ Hydrocephalus. Small pustulous vesicle a little to left of vertex.

nose.text: Smell very acute. Putrid discharge. Ozæna, with fetor and ulceration. Influenza and resulting debility
Tight and stopped up. Tickling, prickling, itching in nostrils. Sense of smell very acute. Ozæna, with great fetor and ulceration.

Smell more acute. Watery discharge from both nostrils, in open air, > indoors, returning when entering a cold room. θ Coryza. Fetid discharge from nose. θ Diphtheria. (In sick :) Same secretion was blown from nose as was hawked from throat. Stinging in left nostril, with watery discharge from nose and eye. Both nostrils plugged up. When blowing nose, mucus bloody, or bright red blood. Nasal membrane so tumefied, must breathe through mouth. θ Scarlatina. Feeling of expansion in nasal passage, when walking out of doors. Tightness in nose between eyes. Sensation at left wing of nose as of fine electric sparks, wants to rub the part repeatedly. Itching of nose. Nasal catarrh, ozæna, discharge very offensive. Epithelioma on nose. A small vesicle formed on centre of nose.

mouth_throat.text: Ulcerated patches on inside of lips and cheeks. Burning in mouth to stomach. Fauces red, and covered with exudation. Uvula whitened and shriveled. Putrid discharge. Almost impossible to swallow. Diphtheria, fetid breath, regurgitation on swallowing liquids, but little pain (Bapt). Face dusky red; white about mouth and nose. Rapid sinking of vital forces

Aching of teeth in r. upper jaw. Lips dry, cracked, painful or black. Tongue burning and tingling, as if a thousand pins were sticking in it. Tongue dry and chippy, parched and fissured. Throat and tongue black, tender and ulcerated patches in inside of lips and cheeks. Intensely bad smell from mouth. Prickling and burning in throat and œsophagus. Heat rising up from the stomach. Spasmodic contraction of œsophagus. Inability to swallow. Sore-throat worse on r. side. Hawking of clear white mucus. Fauces red and covered with a mucous exudation. Uvula whitened and shrivelled.

Aching of teeth of right upper jaw. θ Toothache. Grinding of teeth. θ Hydrocephaloid. Sordes. Coppery metallic taste on tongue and upper palate. Burning and tingling of tongue, as if a thousand pins were pricking it. Burning of tongue, especially on tip. Biting sensation on tongue. Not able to protrude tongue. Tongue trembling and like raw beef. Tongue dry and chippy ; parched and fissured. Tongue : white ; dark brown ; thick, yellow white fur down centre (scarlatina) ; red papillæ project here and there ; shiny, glossy, dry coating ; covered with thick yellow fur. Tongue dark brown coat, sordes. θ Remittent autumnal fever. Profuse secretion of bluish-white frothy saliva. Foaming at mouth ; t. Mouth and throat full of thick, viscid mucus. Swelling and soreness of inner side of left cheek, opposite molars. Thrush, aphthæ, stomatitis. Mouth and tongue black, sordes and ulcerated patches on inside of lips and cheeks. θ Scarlatina. Intensely bad smell from mouth. θ Diphtheria. θ Scarlatina. θ Constipation. White hardened or corrugated patches of mucous membranes ; t. Breath fetid and repulsive. θ Scarlatina. Fauces fiery red, swollen ; diphtheritic patches ; breath almost unbearable. θ Scarlatina. Dryness of posterior nares. Full feeling in throat, with constant desire to swallow. Liquids, on being swallowed, return by nose. θ Scarlatina. Choking feeling in throat, with disposition to hawk up phlegm. Hawking of mucus from pharynx and posterior nares. (In sick :) Tingling, burning, dryness in throat ; later soreness, tumefaction and swelling of surrounding structures. Sharp stitches in throat. Burning in throat and œsophagus, with heat, rising up from stomach. Entire pharynx, uvula and velum palati looked glazed, had reddish, pearly hue, not unlike early manifestations of diphtheria ; tonsils were swollen and involved in like manner. Diphtheria ; exudation imbedded in mucous membrane with fetor oris. Fauces covered with exudate, glands of neck swollen, aphonia, croup-like cough, fetid discharge from nose, violent fever, pulse 130. θ Diphtheria. Spasmodic contraction of œsophagus. Mucous membrane of œsophagus dry, brownish, shrunken. Soreness of throat, < on right side. Pain in throat extending to ear. Throat > while smoking after tea (supper).

stomach_abdomen.text: Appetite lost. Desire for stimulants and tobacco. Constant belching, nausea, vomiting, dark olive green. Heat rises up œsophagus. Flatulent distention of stomach and abdomen. Painful flatulence often marked in one part of the bowel (Sulpho-Carbolate of Soda). Fermentative dyspepsia with bad taste and breath

Wants a drink of water every few minutes. Constant belching up of wind. Vomiting of drunkards. Excessive nausea, and inclination to vomit; while eating a little, after breakfast. Vomiting of: Bright's disease; sea-sickness; cancer; pregnancy. Weight in epigastrium as if burdened with flatulence. Burning in stomach. Total loss of appetite. Desire for whiskey. Pain in r. hypochondrium; also in that region of both sides. Rumbling and rolling in abdomen. Burning in lower part of abdomen and top of head.

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Carb. ac.]. Loss of all appetite. Excessive thirst. (In sick :) Thirst and dryness of mouth and lips ; > by cooling drinks. Desire for whisky and tobacco. Felt as if she had eaten too much. While eating a little breakfast, felt every now and then as if he had to get up and vomit. Hiccough after dinner. Nausea : from cold water ; in morning ; in throat. Constant belching up of wind from stomach. θ Constipation. Fruitless eructations. Acid eructations and formation of gas. (In sick :) Sometimes sweetish regurgitation, at other times bitter or sour, or like buttermilk and cabbage. Vomiting of dark olive green or back fluid ; t. Vomiting, with great restlessness ; t. Vomiting. θ Pregnancy. θ Seasickness. Cancer. Vomiting ; of drunkards ; vomits everything taken into stomach. θ Bright's disease. Chronic vomiting, sarcinæ in vomit. Weight in epigastrium, as though burdened with flatulence ; seeks relief in fruitless eructating, and pressing hand on pit of stomach. Burning in stomach. Distress in stomach, with deathly faintness and great sensitiveness to smells. Empty gone feeling, also with sensation of weight, or with fulness in stomach, and constant desire to swallow. Soreness in stomach and bowels. A great deal of pain changing about from stomach to sides, especially right side and chest. Dyspepsia ; aching in stomach ; diarrhœa, followed by constipation ; colicky pains. Cancer of stomach. Uncomfortable feeling across stomach and liver. Dull pressing pains in hypochondria. Sinking feeling all over abdomen. Rumbling and rolling in abdomen, with a sense of distention. Great tenderness over transverse colon. Bowels feel sore, when walking. Bowels bloated and full of flatus three hours after a meal. Rumbling in bowels, feeling as if diarrhœa would come on after walking about. Flatulence of old age depending on imperfect digestion. Jolting during riding affects unpleasantly the abdominal organs, which feel hot and sore. Burning on outside of abdomen. Abdomen retracted, with constipation. θ Hydrocephalus. A crampy stitch in left inguinal region while sitting. Abdominal muscles feel sore. Itching of lower part of abdomen, as if bitten by something.

Puerperal fever ; high fever alternating with often recurring chills of short duration, followed by profuse sweat with restlessness ; tenderness over uterus and right iliac fossa ; pulse 160 ; diarrhœa, involuntary stools of intolerable odor ; lochia suppressed ; craving for food ; thirst.

M. ; feels as if it would be stiff and sore to move it, but is not felt at all. Sore, bruised feeling, or tingling-itching in leg, during motion. Lower extremities feel heavy as lead. Œdema of both legs ; t. θ Meningitis. Chronic ulcers on feet and ankles. Chronic ulcers on feet and ankles, deep, emitting a strong odor and burning like fire. skin.text: Itching vesicles, with burning pain. Burns tend to ulcerate

_raw: It is antidoted by: Chalk; Saccharated Lime. In burns from carbolic acid, Elias C. Price found milk give immediate relief. He suggests copious draughts of milk in poisoning cases. Compare: Gels. Merc. and Sul. in band-like headache; Ars., Carb. v., Chi. and Kre. in burns, ulcers, unhealthy, offensive discharges; Pic. ac. (tightly drawn iron band at base of brain; Carbl. ac. has this round head); Ant. t. and Variol. in Small-pox.

Antidotes : chalk, but better Calc. sacch., prepared by dissolving sixteen parts refined sugar in forty parts water, and adding five parts slaked lime ; digest three days ; stir occasionally, filter, and evaporate to dryness
Huseman and Wood say, use sweet oil or castor oil as an antidote, as according to Lemaire it will cause the acid to be more slowly absorbed ; emetics are generally useless
Incompatible : glycerine and vegetable oils being solvents spread and increase its action
Compare : Gelsem., Mercur. and Sulphur in bandlike headache ; Arsenic., Carb. veg., Cinchon. and Kreosot. in burns, ulcers, etc., with unhealthy, offensive discharge

dosing.notes: Third to thirtieth potency. Phenol in Arthritis, according to Goodno. Must be absolutely pure. Crystals Solution (25 %) in equal parts of water and glycerine, dose 20 minims well diluted 3 times daily (Bartlett)

mental_emotional.text: Irritability. Disinclination for mental exertion. Muddled, confused, bewildered.

Insensibility. Loss of memory. (In sick :) Forgetfulness, she cannot remember anything, becomes easily confused. (In sick :) She starts to do something and forgets it. (In sick :) She has difficulty of remembering events that have passed. (In sick :) She has periods of mental abstraction. Absentminded, starts when spoken to, nervous tremor. Entire disinclination to study ; what he had accomplished seemed very trifling. Disinclination to mental efforts, event to read. Disinclination for mental or bodily labor. Constantly agitated, moaning continuously and occasionally uttering a piercing cry ; recognizes no one. θ Acute hydrocephalus. Depressed ; morose ; irritable. Cannot see across room. Sensitive to light ; headache. Swimming before eyes. Constant dark spot in front of left eye. Letters seem to run together while writing. Things look as if they were moving backward and forward. Pupils contracted and insensible to light ; t. Alternate contraction and dilatation of pupils. θ Hydrocephalus. Neuralgic twitching in eyeballs. Eyelids open, move up and down constantly ; t. Very severe orbital neuralgia over right eye. Neuralgia of right eye and temple. Slight pain over right eyebrow ; the same kind of pain, but in a milder degree, under right patella ; both of short duration. Acute piercing pain in a small spot on left supraorbital ridge before rising ; spot remains sore to touch. Watering of left eye and watery discharge from nose, in evening. Pains in head affect eye of painful side so much, it is difficult to keep it open.

Face sensitive to touch of towel. Face flushed and burns. θ Headache. Face pale ; and anxious. White circle around mouth, rest of face dusky red. θ Scarlatina. Sallow, soapy and bloodless complexion. Twitching in cheeks and temples. Drawing pain in jaw, right side. Sharp pain about centre of cheek, as if bitten by a mosquito. Itching of face ; of right cheek. A momentary chill runs from face downward, in a hot room. Slight pustular eruption on right side of face. Lupus of face. Cold sweat on face ; t. Slight lividity of lips ; t. Lips dry, cracked, painful or black. θ Scarlatina. Burning on lips.

male.text: Itching, or burning-itching of scrotum, > scratching but it soon returns.

Awakened by strong sexual excitement. Sexual desire very much decreased ; in one case lost for thirteen day. Sexual organs relaxed and weak, lascivious dreams, with weakening seminal emissions. Prickling pain through glans penis and urethra. Intense burning itching of genitals. Itching of scrotum and inside of thighs > by scratching, but it soon returns.

chest_heart.text: Feeling of narrowness in chest as if diaphragm depressed the lungs. Tight feeling, esp. in centre of chest. Pneumonia of (r.) base. Gangrene of lung. Stitches in region of heart. Fearful palpitation night, with great dyspnœa. Jerking in l. common carotid artery while walking rapidly after dinner.

Dull pain through upper lobes of lungs, afternoon. Slight uneasy pains in right lung. Dull aching in left side of chest and abdomen, running around to scapula. Chest feels as if compressed, or as if a load was pressing in front ; desire to dilate chest. Tight feeling in both lungs, especially in outer chest. Feeling of narrowness in chest, as if diaphragm depressed lungs. Oppression of chest and frontal headache, going from left to right. Feeling of expansion in lungs and nasal passages, when walking out of doors. (OBS :) Phthisis pulmonalis. Gangrene of lung. Stitches in region of heart. Bellow murmur over mitral valves ; dyspnœa and palpitation, < at night ; heart < after indiscretion in eating ; must walk very slow on account of heart beating, is exhausted by ascending. θ Organic valvular heart disease, consequent upon inflammatory rheumatism eight years previously. Violent fever, pulse 130. θ Diphtheria. Pulse : rapid (120), feeble and flickering ; intermittent, sometimes slow ; feeble and flickering ; small and rapid. Pulse irregular. θ Hydrocephaloid. Pulse 160. θ Puerperal fever. Transient dull pain under left clavicle. Sensation as of fine electric sparks on sternal end of right clavicle. Dull pressure under sternum, in region of sixth rib. (In sick :) Slight tingling along left side of chest. Cold sweat on chest ; t. Scirrhous cancer of left breast. Carb. ac., 2d dec., every two hours for two years.

back.text: Neck stiff, lame and sore. Severe pain in lumbo-sacral region, latter part of night. Pain in loins on straightening one's self and by jolting while riding.

Jerking in left common carotid artery while walking rapidly after dinner. Twitching in right sterno-cleido-mastoid muscle ; t. θ Meningitis. Stitching pains in right side of neck. Drawing in muscles of neck. Neck feels lame and stiff, when moving head. Neck very stiff and sore ; feels as if he had taken a bad cold. θ Remittent fever. Very great sense of weight on neck, with tenderness even to touch, on seventh cervical vertebra. Glands of neck swollen. θ Diphtheria. Itching of back of neck and back. Aching pains in small of back, < when straightening, from jolting when riding, > by pressure. She has dragging sensation across loins and throughout pelvis. Boring pains in small of back, with a cold. Severe pain in lumbo-sacral region, mostly during latter part of night, of long standing. Soreness of muscles of back and limbs.

sleep.text: Yawning and sleepy. Waking often in night. Copyright © Médi-T ® 2000 Main.

Yawning, with desire to take long inspirations. Constant inclination to yawn, languid and sleepy, desire to stretch. (In sick :) She slept by spells ; sleep unsatisfactory ; fitful starting. Sleeps uneasily, starts ; eyes half closed. θ Scarlatina. Wakes often during night. Heavy and sleepy, perplexed with dreams, wakes unrefreshed. Somnolency, sopor, ending in coma. Dreams : unable to recall ; of fire ; amorous ; of traveling.

ears.text: Pressing pain in left ear, transient. (In sick :) She had a tingling, numb feeling in ear, followed by humming, buzzing sound. (In sick :) Beating pain with a humming sound in both ears. (In sick :) Meatus auditorius externum excoriated and covered with small pustular eruption, extending inward. Pain from throat extends into ear. Itching of right ear.

respiratory.text: VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Carb. ac.]. Aphonia. Diphtheria. Soreness of respiratory organs, with hoarseness. Hoarseness, with stiff neck. Hawking of clear white mucus. Left side of larynx very sore to pressure. Tickling in throat causing short hacking cough. Catarrhal croup. Chronic laryngitis and bronchitis. (In sick :) Respiration uneven and irregular. Stertorous respiration. Difficult respiration, with sense of oppression. Desire to take long inspirations, with yawning. Sighing or moaning expirations ; t. (In sick :) Her breath was hot and feverish. Shortness of breath on going up hill or up-stairs. Dyspnœa at night. Constant inclination to cough. Short, dry, hacking cough, with tickling in throat ; can hardly retain anything on stomach. Troublesome cough, with foul tenacious expectoration. Croup-like cough. θ Diphtheria. Whooping cough, with redness of face, watering of eyes and frontal headache. Expectoration of a large quantity of thick, whitish mucus.

modalities.text: REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Carb. ac.]. Lying : in bed, tired. Sitting : down < vertigo ; crampy stitch left inguinal region. Bending : head forward < headache. Stooping : coldness in head. Writing : letters run together. Walking : fast > vertigo ; rumbling in bowels ; pain in l. ovary ; up-stairs, short breath ; out-doors, feeling of expansion in lungs and nasal passages ; heart beats. Night : dyspepsia < ; fearful beating of heart ; severe pain in lumbo-sacral region ; wakes often ; sweat. Morning : headache in upper half of head ; nausea. All day up to 4 o'clock ; aching pain beneath patella. Room feels close and hot. Cold : hand, pressure > aching and burning pain in forehead ; water, nausea. Open air : chilly ; watery discharge from both nostrils ; walking in, pain in region of left ovary.

fever_chill.text: Chilly sensation while in a warm room. Chill in open air. A momentary chill runs from face downward, in a hot room. Chill, followed by fever and very slight sweat, with numb ache in arms and legs ; pulse small and rapid ; < about sundown and through night ; felt as if he had taken a bad cold. High fever, alternating with often recurring chills of short duration, followed by profuse sweat, with restlessness. θ Puerperal fever. Was covered with perspiration. Sweat at night. Typhoid and low miasmatic fevers. Fever of enteric type. Remittent fever, occurring every autumn. Intermittent fever, with enlargement of spleen. Scarlet fever.
